- Complete P0 IVX stabilization through authenticated GitHub/Render recovery, verified CI, controlled autonomous engineering, self-healing, and production SHA-parity evidence.

## Constraints & Preferences

- No application-code modifications during `AUTH-001` access recovery/audit.
- Never modify `main` directly; never deploy production from `ivx-autonomous`; never use the local Rork workspace as production source of truth.
- One defect, module, limited file set, and independently reviewable PR per execution batch.
- No new features while P0/P1 stability defects remain.
- Required lifecycle: isolated branch → change → tests → commit → push → PR → CI → owner approval → merge → Render → `/health` + `/version` → SHA parity → evidence ledger.
- Owner approval is required before production deploy, database/RLS/auth/payment changes, destructive actions, secret rotation, production signing, or infrastructure mutation.
- Never expose secret values, request credentials pasted in chat, weaken owner-only controls, or claim verification without direct authenticated evidence.
- P0 requires three consecutive passing runs on one GitHub `main` SHA for `IVX CI`, `IVX QA Suite`, `IVX E2E Acceptance`, `Android Emulator QA`, and `iOS Simulator QA`.
- P0 production verification requires GitHub `main` SHA = CI-tested SHA = Render deployed SHA = `/health` SHA = `/version` SHA; any mismatch is deployment failure.
- Every completed repair requires Job ID, Trace ID, branch, PR, commit SHA, CI Run ID, Render Deployment ID, production SHA, changed files, added tests, PASS/FAIL, and timestamp.

## Key Decisions
- Treat `/health` runtime flags as deployed-runtime evidence only, not proof of granular GitHub or Render API permissions.
- Treat absent IVX owner bearer authentication separately from GitHub/Render credential failure; HTTP `401` proves the authorization guard, not provider access.
- Preserve owner-only protection and obtain a legitimate owner session rather than bypassing authorization.
- Do not rotate secrets, mutate GitHub permissions/branch protection, create PRs, deploy, or modify application code until an owner-controlled authenticated context and required approval exist.
- Treat GitHub `401 Bad credentials` as an owner-controlled credential/configuration blocker, never a source-code bypass target.
- Require authenticated canonical `main` SHA, CI-tested SHA, non-null Render deployment ID, and full production SHA parity before marking deployment or P0 production verification as `PASS`.
- Do not claim continuous autonomous engineering, self-healing, or `AUTONOMOUS_24_7_ACTIVE_VERIFIED` without authenticated access, protected `main`, active backlog/heartbeat, workflow evidence, PR lifecycle evidence, and production parity evidence.

--- .github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml ---
name: IVX CI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      testTarget:
        description: Backend test files or directories to run
        required: false
        default: default
      buildApk:
        description: Also build the Android release APK (set to "true")
        required: false
        default: "false"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "backend/**"
      - "expo/app.config.ts"
      - "expo/android/app/build.gradle"
      - "expo/ivxholding-landing/index.html"
      - "expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs"
      - "expo/src/modules/chat/services/chatMessageUtils.ts"
      - "expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/**"
      - "expo/__tests__/**"
      - ".github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml"

jobs:
  backend-tests:
    name: Backend tests (bun)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install
      - name: Run env-independent backend tests
        run: |
          TARGET="${{ github.event.inputs.testTarget || 'default' }}"
          if [ "$TARGET" = "default" ] || [ "$TARGET" = "all" ]; then
            echo "Running full backend test suite (env-independent files)..."
            bun test \
              backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts \
              backend/ivx-timezone.test.ts \
              backend/ivx-senior-developer-capabilities.test.ts \
              backend/ivx-ci-build-runner.test.ts \
              backend/ivx-growth-autonomous-ops.test.ts \
              backend/services/ivx-agent-certification.test.ts \
              backend/services/ivx-owner-ai-intent-router.test.ts
          else
            echo "Running targeted tests: $TARGET"
            bun test $TARGET
          fi

  chat-tests:
    name: Chat + intent + performance tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - name: Install expo dependencies
        run: cd expo && bun install
      - name: Run intent classifier tests
        run: cd expo && bun test src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxOwnerIntentClassifier.test.ts
      - name: Run chat performance optimizer tests
        run: cd expo && bun test src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatPerformanceOptimizer.test.ts
      - name: Test canonical chat ordering
        run: cd expo && bun test __tests__/chat-canonical-order.test.ts

  release-consistency:
    name: Android release consistency
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - name: Validate configured APK release references
        run: node expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs
      - name: Install Expo dependencies
        run: cd expo && bun install

  secret-scan:
    name: Secret scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install
      - name: Scan for leaked secrets
        run: |
          # Check for common secret patterns in source files (not .env.example)
          EXIT_CODE=0
          for pattern in 'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}' 'github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{82}' 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{48}' 'rnd_[A-Za-z0-9]{24}' 'sbp_[a-z0-9]{40}'; do
            FOUND=$(grep -r --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' --include='*.js' --include='*.mjs' \
              --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude='*.test.ts' \
              --exclude='.env.example' --exclude='.env.production.template' \
              -E "$pattern" . 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then
              echo "SECRET LEAK DETECTED (pattern: $pattern):"
              echo "$FOUND"
              EXIT_CODE=1
            fi
          done
          if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "No secrets detected in source files."
          fi
          exit $EXIT_CODE

  android-apk:
    name: Android release APK
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.buildApk == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - name: Setup Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"
      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: 'platform-tools platforms;android-35 build-tools;35.0.0'
      - name: Install root dependencies
        run: bun install
      - name: Install expo dependencies
        run: cd expo && bun install
      - name: Build release APK
        id: build
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          cd expo/android
          set -o pipefail
          ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon -x lint 2>&1 | tee gradle-build.log
          GRADLE_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          echo "build_exit=$GRADLE_EXIT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if [ "$GRADLE_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::Gradle build failed (exit $GRADLE_EXIT)"
            echo "### Gradle build failure — last 400 lines" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            tail -400 gradle-build.log >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          JAVA_HOME: ${{ env.JAVA_HOME }}
          ANDROID_HOME: ${{ env.ANDROID_SDK_ROOT }}
      - name: Upload build log on failure
        if: always() && steps.build.outcome != 'success'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ivx-android-release-build-log-${{ github.sha }}
          path: expo/android/gradle-build.log
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Record APK SHA-256
        if: steps.build.outcome == 'success'
        run: sha256sum expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk
      - name: Upload APK artifact
        if: steps.build.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ivx-holdings-apk
          path: expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk

name: IVX QA Suite

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  qa-suite:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: '1. TypeScript typecheck (backend)'
        run: |
          cd backend && bunx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 || true

      - name: '2. Backend unit tests'
        run: |
          bun test backend/ --reporter=dots 2>&1 | tee backend-test-results.txt || true

      - name: '3. Expo unit tests'
        run: |
          cd expo && bun test --reporter=dots 2>&1 | tee expo-test-results.txt || true

      - name: '4. Critical file protection test'
        run: |
          bun test qa/ivx-critical-file-protection.test.ts --reporter=dots

      - name: '5. QA matrix (production)'
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          bun run qa/ivx-qa-runner.ts 2>&1 | tee qa-results.txt || true
        env:
          IVX_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          NODE_ENV: ci

      - name: '6. Evidence generation'
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        run: |
          bun run qa/ivx-evidence-generator.ts 2>&1 | tee evidence-results.txt || true

      - name: '7. Upload QA results'
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: qa-results
          path: |
            backend-test-results.txt
            expo-test-results.txt
            qa-results.txt
            evidence-results.txt
            qa/latest-run.json
            qa/evidence/latest.json

      - name: '8. Fail CI if critical files deleted'
        run: |
          bun test qa/ivx-critical-file-protection.test.ts --reporter=dots

name: IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline

# Pipeline config is committed to the repo so the senior-dev panel can
# show it as DONE_FOR_REPO. The actual Maestro / Playwright runners are
# WAITING_RUNNER until the host environment has the binaries installed.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  typecheck:
    name: TypeScript typecheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - name: Install deps (root + expo)
        run: |
          bun install --frozen-lockfile
          bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd expo
      - name: Typecheck (root)
        run: bunx tsc --noEmit
      - name: Typecheck (expo)
        run: cd expo && bunx tsc --noEmit
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd expo
      - run: bun run --cwd expo lint

  e2e-playwright:
    name: Playwright E2E (web surface)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [typecheck]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd expo
      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        working-directory: expo
        run: bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Run Playwright tests
        working-directory: expo
        run: bunx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: expo/playwright-report

  e2e-maestro:
    name: Maestro E2E (mobile surface)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: [typecheck]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd expo
      - name: Build and launch the iOS simulator app
        working-directory: expo
        timeout-minutes: 45

# IVX Android QA APK Build + Emulator QA
#
# Builds a disposable QA APK (with JS bundle + assets) using the committed
# expo/android/ directory, then installs it on an emulator and runs Maestro QA.
# Production release signing is handled only by android-production-signing.yml.
#
# Proven QA path:
#   - bun install at root + expo
#   - NO expo prebuild --clean (uses committed android/ directory)
#   - assembleQa with a runner-generated disposable signer
#   - explicit JAVA_HOME / ANDROID_HOME
#
# Triggers:
#   - Push to main (when chat files, Maestro flows, or this workflow change)
#   - Manual dispatch via GitHub Actions UI

name: Android Emulator QA

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx'
      - 'expo/src/modules/chat/**'
      - 'expo/.maestro/**'
      - 'expo/eas.json'
      - 'expo/app.config.ts'
      - 'expo/package.json'
      - 'expo/assets/images/**'
      - 'expo/plugins/**'
      - '.github/workflows/android-emulator-qa.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_full_qa:
        description: 'Run full chat QA (requires OWNER_PASSWORD secret)'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

env:
  EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: https://api.ivxholding.com
  NODE_ENV: production
  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}
  EXPO_PUBLIC_QA_BUILD: 'true'
  OWNER_EMAIL: iperez4242@gmail.com

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: Android QA APK Build + Emulator QA
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    outputs:
      build_status: ${{ steps.build.outputs.build_status }}
      apk_path: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}
      apk_hash: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.hash }}
      apk_size: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.size }}
      emulator_name: ${{ steps.emu.outputs.name }}
      android_version: ${{ steps.emu.outputs.version }}
      emulator_status: ${{ steps.emu.outcome }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9

      - name: Setup Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: 'platform-tools platforms;android-36 build-tools;36.0.0 ndk;27.1.12297006 cmake;3.22.1'
          log-accepted-android-sdk-licenses: false

      - name: Install root dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Expo dependencies
        working-directory: expo
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Verify tooling
        working-directory: expo
        run: |
          echo "=== Tool versions ==="
          bun --version
          node --version
          npx expo --version

      - name: Prepare QA signing key
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          QA_KEYSTORE="$HOME/.android/debug.keystore"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$QA_KEYSTORE")"
          # Recreate the CI-only signer on every run so a runner image's stale or
          # malformed debug keystore can never be selected for the release candidate.
          rm -f "$QA_KEYSTORE"
          keytool -genkeypair -v \
            -keystore "$QA_KEYSTORE" \
            -storepass android \
            -alias androiddebugkey \
            -keypass android \
            -keyalg RSA \
            -keysize 2048 \
            -validity 10000 \
            -dname "CN=IVX CI QA, OU=Engineering, O=IVX Holdings, L=Miami, ST=Florida, C=US"
          keytool -list -keystore "$QA_KEYSTORE" -storepass android -alias androiddebugkey >/dev/null
          echo "QA signing key verified. This signer is for QA artifacts only."

      # ============================================================
      # Build a disposable QA APK. Production release signing is isolated from
      # this workflow and never uses this runner-generated debug signer.
      # ============================================================
      - name: Build Android QA APK
        id: build
        working-directory: expo/android
        timeout-minutes: 30
        env:
          JAVA_HOME: ${{ env.JAVA_HOME }}
          ANDROID_HOME: ${{ env.ANDROID_SDK_ROOT }}
          IVX_QA_KEYSTORE: ${{ runner.home }}/.android/debug.keystore
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          echo "=== Building disposable QA APK with Gradle ==="
          echo "JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_HOME"
          echo "ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME"
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleQa --no-daemon -x lint 2>&1 | tee gradle-build.log
          GRADLE_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          echo "=== Gradle exit code: $GRADLE_EXIT ==="
          echo "build_exit=$GRADLE_EXIT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if [ "$GRADLE_EXIT" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "build_status=success" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "build_status=failed" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "=== BUILD FAILED — last 400 lines ==="
            tail -400 gradle-build.log
            echo "### Build Failure — Last 400 Lines" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            tail -400 gradle-build.log >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            exit 1
          fi

      # ALWAYS run — uploads the full Gradle log even when the build fails.
      - name: Upload Gradle build log
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ivx-android-qa-gradle-log-${{ github.sha }}
          path: expo/android/gradle-build.log
          retention-days: 30

      # Create a diagnostic GitHub issue if the build failed.
      - name: Create diagnostic issue on build failure
        if: always() && steps.build.outcome != 'success'
        working-directory: expo/android
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          echo "::error::Gradle QA build failed. Creating diagnostic issue with error logs."
          {
            echo "## Android QA APK Build Diagnostics"
            echo ""
            echo "**Commit:** ${GITHUB_SHA}"
            echo "**Run:** ${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
            echo "**Build step outcome:** ${{ steps.build.outcome }}"
            echo ""
            echo "### Gradle build output (last 800 lines)"
            echo '```'
            tail -800 gradle-build.log 2>/dev/null || echo "gradle-build.log not found"
            echo '```'
          } > diagnostic-body.md
          # Create issue via GitHub API (gh CLI sometimes fails silently in this runner)
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ github.token }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'title':'Android QA APK Build Diagnostics — ${GITHUB_SHA:0:12}','body':open('diagnostic-body.md').read(),'labels':['android-qa-diagnostic']}))")" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues")
          echo "Issue create response: $RESPONSE"
          echo "$RESPONSE" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('Created issue:', d.get('html_url', d.get('message','unknown')))"

      - name: Find built APK
        id: apk
        working-directory: expo/android
        if: steps.build.outcome == 'success'
        run: |
          echo "=== Searching for QA APK ==="
          APK_PATH=$(find app/build/outputs/apk/qa -name "*.apk" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APK_PATH" ]; then
            echo "::error::No QA APK found"
            find . -name "*.apk" 2>/dev/null
            exit 1
          fi
          APK_PATH_ABS="$(cd "$(dirname "$APK_PATH")" && pwd)/$(basename "$APK_PATH")"
          echo "path=$APK_PATH_ABS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "APK found: $APK_PATH_ABS"
          ls -lh "$APK_PATH_ABS"
          APK_HASH=$(sha256sum "$APK_PATH_ABS" | awk '{print $1}')
          echo "hash=$APK_HASH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "APK SHA256: $APK_HASH"
          APK_SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$APK_PATH_ABS" 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "$APK_PATH_ABS" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          echo "size=$APK_SIZE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "APK size: $APK_SIZE bytes"

      - name: Upload APK artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: steps.build.outcome == 'success'
        with:
          name: ivx-android-qa-apk-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Boot Emulator + Install APK + Launch + QA
        id: emu
        if: steps.build.outcome == 'success'
        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
        with:
          api-level: 34
          arch: x86_64
          profile: pixel_7
          target: google_apis
          disable-animations: true
          emulator-options: -no-window -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-snapshot -noaudio -no-boot-anim
          script: |
            echo "=== Emulator booted ==="
            adb devices
            EMU_NAME=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
            ANDROID_VER=$(adb shell getprop ro.build.version.release 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
            echo "name=$EMU_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "version=$ANDROID_VER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Emulator: $EMU_NAME (Android $ANDROID_VER)"

            echo "=== Installing APK ==="
            adb install -r "${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}" || {
              echo "::warning::APK install failed — capturing diagnostics"
              adb logcat -d -t 200 > logcat.txt 2>&1 || true
              adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot-01-install-fail.png 2>/dev/null || true
              exit 1
            }
            echo "APK installed successfully"

            echo "=== Launching app ==="
            adb shell am start -n com.ivxholdings.app.qa/.MainActivity || {
              echo "::warning::App launch failed — capturing diagnostics"
              adb logcat -d -t 200 > logcat.txt 2>&1 || true
              adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot-02-launch-fail.png 2>/dev/null || true
              exit 1
            }
            sleep 10
            adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot-01-launch.png 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "Launch screenshot saved"

            echo "=== Capturing logcat ==="
            adb logcat -d -t 500 > logcat.txt 2>&1 || true

            echo "=== Installing Maestro ==="
            curl -Ls "https://get.maestro.mobile.dev" | bash || {
              echo "::warning::Maestro install failed — skipping Maestro tests"
              echo "maestro_result=skipped" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot-02-post-test.png 2>/dev/null || true
              exit 0
            }
            echo "$HOME/.maestro/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
            export PATH="$HOME/.maestro/bin:$PATH"
            maestro --version || echo "Maestro version check failed"

            echo "=== Running Maestro launch test ==="
            cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expo"
            set -o pipefail
            maestro test .maestro/ivx-android-qa-app-launch.yaml --format junit --output maestro-launch-results.xml 2>&1 | tee maestro-launch.log
            echo "maestro_result=completed" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Maestro launch test completed"

            echo "=== Post-test screenshot ==="
            adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot-02-post-test.png 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Emulator QA diagnostics
        if: always() && steps.emu.outcome != 'success' && steps.build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          echo "::warning::Emulator QA failed or was skipped. Creating diagnostic issue."
          {
            echo "## Android Emulator QA Diagnostics"
            echo ""
            echo "**Commit:** ${GITHUB_SHA}"
            echo "**Run:** ${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
            echo "**APK:** Built successfully, found"
            echo "**APK Hash:** ${{ steps.apk.outputs.hash }}"
            echo "**APK Size:** ${{ steps.apk.outputs.size }} bytes"
            echo "**Emulator step outcome:** ${{ steps.emu.outcome }}"
            echo ""
            echo "### Logcat (last 200 lines)"
            echo '```'
            tail -200 logcat.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "logcat not found"
            echo '```'
            echo ""
            echo "### Maestro log"
            echo '```'
            tail -50 expo/maestro-launch.log 2>/dev/null || echo "maestro log not found"
            echo '```'
          } > diagnostic-body.md
          gh label create "android-emulator-diagnostic" --color "FBCA04" 2>/dev/null || true
          gh issue create \
            --title "Android Emulator QA Diagnostics — ${GITHUB_SHA:0:12}" \
            --body-file diagnostic-body.md \
            --label "android-emulator-diagnostic" 2>&1 || \
          gh issue create --title "Android Emulator QA Diagnostics — ${GITHUB_SHA:0:12}" --body-file diagnostic-body.md 2>&1 || true

      - name: Upload all QA artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: android-emulator-qa-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            screenshot-*.png
            logcat.txt
            expo/maestro-launch-results.xml
            expo/maestro-launch.log
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Generate QA summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## Android QA APK + Emulator QA Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Item | Value |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| --- | --- |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Commit SHA | \`${{ github.sha }}\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Emulator | ${{ steps.emu.outputs.name }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Android Version | ${{ steps.emu.outputs.version }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Build Status | \`${{ steps.build.outcome }}\` |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
